src-60.text: Source found for the 6 in 10 stat: DealerRater survey for Fixed Ops Journal (2019), via CBT News. Exact figure is 61 of 100 service customers never offered additional work. Details and link in the Notion Stats database. Suggest citing it in a footnote and using 61, not 6 in 10.
